situation: Thanking someone for dinner
chinese_ai: 谢谢你们准备晚饭，特别好吃！
pinyin_ai: Xièxie nǐmen zhǔnbèi wǎnfàn，tèbié hǎochī!
english_ai: Thanks for making dinner. It was delicious!

situation: Thanking someone for their notes
chinese_ai: 谢谢你把笔记发给我，帮了我大忙！
pinyin_ai: Xièxie nǐ bǎ bǐjì fā gěi wǒ，bāng le wǒ dà máng!
english_ai: Thanks for sending me your notes. They really helped!

situation: Thanking a teacher for an explanation
context: After extra help with a lesson
chinese_ai: 谢谢老师，我现在明白了！
pinyin_ai: Xièxie lǎoshī，wǒ xiànzài míngbai le!
english_ai: Thank you for explaining. I understand now!

situation: Apologizing for a late reply
chinese_ai: 不好意思，刚看到消息！
pinyin_ai: Bù hǎoyìsi，gāng kàndào xiāoxi!
english_ai: Sorry! I only just saw your message!

situation: Apologizing for running late
context: On the way to a study session
chinese_ai: 不好意思，我可能要晚到十分钟。
pinyin_ai: Bù hǎoyìsi，wǒ kěnéng yào wǎn dào shí fēnzhōng.
english_ai: Sorry! I might be ten minutes late.

situation: Apologizing for sending the wrong file
chinese_ai: 老师，不好意思，我刚才发错文件了，现在重新发给您。
pinyin_ai: Lǎoshī，bù hǎoyìsi，wǒ gāngcái fā cuò wénjiàn le，xiànzài chóngxīn fā gěi nín.
english_ai: Sorry! I sent the wrong file. I'll send you the correct one now.

situation: Inviting someone for coffee
chinese_ai: 周末有空吗？一起喝杯咖啡吧！
pinyin_ai: Zhōumò yǒu kòng ma? Yìqǐ hē bēi kāfēi ba!
english_ai: Are you free this weekend? Let's grab a coffee!

situation: Inviting someone to lunch
chinese_ai: 下课后要不要一起吃午饭？
pinyin_ai: Xiàkè hòu yào bu yào yìqǐ chī wǔfàn?
english_ai: Want to have lunch together after class?

situation: Inviting someone for a walk
chinese_ai: 晚上要不要一起出去散步？
pinyin_ai: Wǎnshang yào bu yào yìqǐ chūqù sànbù?
english_ai: Would you like to go for a walk together tonight?

situation: Asking someone to take a photo
chinese_ai: 能帮我拍张照吗？
pinyin_ai: Néng bāng wǒ pāi zhāng zhào ma?
english_ai: Could you take a photo of me?

situation: Asking someone to save a seat
chinese_ai: 能帮我留个座位吗？我马上到。
pinyin_ai: Néng bāng wǒ liú ge zuòwèi ma? Wǒ mǎshàng dào.
english_ai: Could you save me a seat? I'll be there soon.

situation: Asking someone to collect a package
context: A delivery while away from home
chinese_ai: 我今天不在家，能麻烦您帮我收一下快递吗？
pinyin_ai: Wǒ jīntiān bú zài jiā，néng máfan nín bāng wǒ shōu yíxià kuàidì ma?
english_ai: I'm away from home today. Could you please receive a package for me?

situation: Declining a dinner invitation
chinese_ai: 谢谢你叫我，不过我今晚有事，下次一起吃吧！
pinyin_ai: Xièxie nǐ jiào wǒ，búguò wǒ jīnwǎn yǒu shì，xià cì yìqǐ chī ba!
english_ai: Thanks for inviting me! I'm busy tonight. Let's eat together another time!

situation: Declining a study invitation
chinese_ai: 不好意思，我下午没空，这次就不一起复习了。
pinyin_ai: Bù hǎoyìsi，wǒ xiàwǔ méi kòng，zhè cì jiù bù yìqǐ fùxí le.
english_ai: Sorry! I'm busy this afternoon and can't join you to study this time.

situation: Declining an offer of a ride
chinese_ai: 谢谢您，不用来接我了，我坐地铁回去就行。
pinyin_ai: Xièxie nín，bú yòng lái jiē wǒ le，wǒ zuò dìtiě huíqù jiù xíng.
english_ai: Thank you! You don't need to pick me up. I can take the subway back.

situation: Congratulating someone on passing an exam
chinese_ai: 恭喜你通过考试！
pinyin_ai: Gōngxǐ nǐ tōngguò kǎoshì!
english_ai: Congratulations on passing the exam!

situation: Congratulating someone on a new job
chinese_ai: 恭喜你找到新工作！有空一起庆祝一下！
pinyin_ai: Gōngxǐ nǐ zhǎodào xīn gōngzuò! Yǒu kòng yìqǐ qìngzhù yíxià!
english_ai: Congratulations on the new job! Let's celebrate when you're free!

situation: Checking in on a sick friend
context: The day after hearing they are ill
chinese_ai: 今天感觉好点了吗？多休息呀。
pinyin_ai: Jīntiān gǎnjué hǎo diǎn le ma? Duō xiūxi ya.
english_ai: Are you feeling any better today? Get plenty of rest.

situation: Checking in on a sick host family member
context: While staying with a host family
chinese_ai: 您今天好点了吗？需要我帮您买点什么吗？
pinyin_ai: Nín jīntiān hǎo diǎn le ma? Xūyào wǒ bāng nín mǎi diǎn shénme ma?
english_ai: Are you feeling better today? Can I pick anything up for you?

situation: Offering notes to a sick classmate
chinese_ai: 听说你生病了，今天的笔记要不要我发给你？
pinyin_ai: Tīngshuō nǐ shēngbìng le，jīntiān de bǐjì yào bu yào wǒ fā gěi nǐ?
english_ai: I heard you're sick. Would you like me to send you today's notes?

situation: Asking for help understanding homework
chinese_ai: 这道题我没看懂，你能给我讲一下吗？
pinyin_ai: Zhè dào tí wǒ méi kàndǒng，nǐ néng gěi wǒ jiǎng yíxià ma?
english_ai: I don't understand this question. Could you explain it to me?

situation: Asking a teacher about homework instructions
chinese_ai: 老师，请问这次作业要写多少字？
pinyin_ai: Lǎoshī，qǐngwèn zhè cì zuòyè yào xiě duōshao zì?
english_ai: How many Chinese characters should we write for this assignment?

situation: Asking for help checking Chinese homework
chinese_ai: 你有空帮我看看中文作业吗？我怕有些句子不太自然。
pinyin_ai: Nǐ yǒu kòng bāng wǒ kànkan Zhōngwén zuòyè ma? Wǒ pà yǒuxiē jùzi bú tài zìrán.
english_ai: Do you have time to check my Chinese homework? I'm worried some sentences sound unnatural.

situation: Confirming a meeting time
chinese_ai: 我们明天下午三点见，对吧？
pinyin_ai: Wǒmen míngtiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn jiàn，duì ba?
english_ai: We're meeting tomorrow at three in the afternoon, right?

situation: Confirming a meeting place
chinese_ai: 我们是在图书馆门口见吗？
pinyin_ai: Wǒmen shì zài túshūguǎn ménkǒu jiàn ma?
english_ai: Are we meeting at the library entrance?

situation: Confirming an appointment with a teacher
chinese_ai: 老师，想跟您确认一下，我们明天下午两点见面，对吗？
pinyin_ai: Lǎoshī，xiǎng gēn nín quèrèn yíxià，wǒmen míngtiān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn jiànmiàn，duì ma?
english_ai: I'd like to confirm that we're meeting tomorrow at two in the afternoon. Is that right?

situation: Cancelling plans because of illness
chinese_ai: 不好意思，我今天不太舒服，不能跟你出去了，我们改天再约吧。
pinyin_ai: Bù hǎoyìsi，wǒ jīntiān bú tài shūfu，bù néng gēn nǐ chūqù le，wǒmen gǎitiān zài yuē ba.
english_ai: Sorry! I'm not feeling well and can't go out with you today. Let's meet another day.

situation: Cancelling a study session
chinese_ai: 不好意思，我临时有事，今天没法一起复习了。
pinyin_ai: Bù hǎoyìsi，wǒ línshí yǒu shì，jīntiān méi fǎ yìqǐ fùxí le.
english_ai: Sorry! Something came up and I can't study with you today.

situation: Cancelling a meeting with a teacher
chinese_ai: 老师，不好意思，我明天有事，没法按时见面了，可以改个时间吗？
pinyin_ai: Lǎoshī，bù hǎoyìsi，wǒ míngtiān yǒu shì，méi fǎ ànshí jiànmiàn le，kěyǐ gǎi ge shíjiān ma?
english_ai: I'm sorry! Something has come up tomorrow and I can't make our meeting. Could we reschedule?

situation: Wishing a friend a happy birthday
chinese_ai: 生日快乐！祝你天天开心！
pinyin_ai: Shēngrì kuàilè! Zhù nǐ tiāntiān kāixīn!
english_ai: Happy birthday! Wishing you happiness every day!

situation: Wishing a host family member a happy birthday
chinese_ai: 祝您生日快乐！谢谢您一直这么照顾我。
pinyin_ai: Zhù nín shēngrì kuàilè! Xièxie nín yìzhí zhème zhàogù wǒ.
english_ai: Happy birthday! Thank you for always taking such good care of me.

situation: Sending Chinese New Year wishes
chinese_ai: 新年快乐！祝你和家人身体健康，万事顺利！
pinyin_ai: Xīnnián kuàilè! Zhù nǐ hé jiārén shēntǐ jiànkāng，wànshì shùnlì!
english_ai: Happy New Year! Wishing you and your family good health and all the best!

situation: Sending Mid-Autumn Festival wishes
chinese_ai: 中秋快乐！希望你们今天过得开心！
pinyin_ai: Zhōngqiū kuàilè! Xīwàng nǐmen jīntiān guò de kāixīn!
english_ai: Happy Mid-Autumn Festival! Hope you all have a lovely day!

situation: Sending Teachers' Day wishes
chinese_ai: 老师，教师节快乐！谢谢您的耐心指导。
pinyin_ai: Lǎoshī，Jiàoshī Jié kuàilè! Xièxie nín de nàixīn zhǐdǎo.
english_ai: Happy Teachers' Day! Thank you for your patient guidance.

situation: Asking to borrow a charger
context: A low phone battery at school
chinese_ai: 我的手机快没电了，能借你的充电器用一下吗？
pinyin_ai: Wǒ de shǒujī kuài méi diàn le，néng jiè nǐ de chōngdiànqì yòng yíxià ma?
english_ai: My phone is almost dead. Could I borrow your charger?

situation: Asking to borrow an umbrella
context: Before going out in the rain
chinese_ai: 外面下雨了，我可以借一下您的伞吗？
pinyin_ai: Wàimian xià yǔ le，wǒ kěyǐ jiè yíxià nín de sǎn ma?
english_ai: It's raining outside. Could I borrow your umbrella?

situation: Asking to borrow a book
chinese_ai: 你那本书看完了吗？能借我看几天吗？
pinyin_ai: Nǐ nà běn shū kàn wán le ma? Néng jiè wǒ kàn jǐ tiān ma?
english_ai: Have you finished that book? Could I borrow it for a few days?

situation: Sending a first message to a new friend
context: After meeting at a language exchange
chinese_ai: 你好！我是今天语言交换活动上认识的Alex，很高兴认识你！
pinyin_ai: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ shì jīntiān yǔyán jiāohuàn huódòng shàng rènshi de Alex，hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ!
english_ai: Hi! It's Alex from today's language exchange. Great to meet you!

situation: Sending a first message to a classmate
chinese_ai: 你好，我是和你一起上中文课的Alex，以后多多交流！
pinyin_ai: Nǐ hǎo，wǒ shì hé nǐ yìqǐ shàng Zhōngwén kè de Alex，yǐhòu duōduō jiāoliú!
english_ai: Hi! I'm Alex from your Chinese class. Looking forward to chatting more!

situation: Sending a first message to a teacher
context: After adding a teacher on WeChat
chinese_ai: 老师您好，我是您班上的新同学Alex，以后请多指教！
pinyin_ai: Lǎoshī nín hǎo，wǒ shì nín bān shàng de xīn tóngxué Alex，yǐhòu qǐng duō zhǐjiào!
english_ai: Hello! I'm Alex
decision: a new student in your class. I look forward to learning from you!
